name: mkos3-threads-dark

name: mkos5-threads-needsyou-cream
js: (async () => { const w = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mkword')).find((x) => /threads/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (w) w.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); const c = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mkbar .mkchips:not(.leave) > button')).find((x) => /needs you/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (c) c.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 500)); })()
